description: This file defines the ClaimExpenseAPI class, which provides API endpoints for managing claim expenses within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting claim expense records, adhering to RESTful conventions, and uses annotations for API documentation. The class interacts with data models, services, and traits to enforce business logic, validation, and transactions.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseAPI
classes.description: This class provides REST API endpoints for managing claim expenses, including CRUD operations, within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of claim expenses associated with a specific request ID, with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new claim expense record based on provided request parameters.

methods.name: setClaimExpense
methods.description: Populates a ClaimExpense entity with data from request parameters, handling creation or update logic.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes claim expenses associated with a specific request ID, given a list of expense IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific claim expense by its ID within a given request.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing claim expense record identified by its ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' endpoint invocation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a claim expense.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting claim expenses.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single claim expense.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a claim expense.
